findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

Inspector observed no sanitizer prepared in the facility during food preparation and service. Education was conducted on sanitizer requirements and a sanitizer bucket was prepared, measuring 200ppm quaternary ammonia. Ensure a spray bottle is prepared at all times to ensure proper sanitization of food-contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the interior baffles of the ice machine to be soiled with microbial growth. The PIC was informed and plans to submit a service ticket for the ice machine. A follow-up will be conducted on October 5, 2026 to ensure the ice machine is cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no test strips available in the facility. Education was conducted and test strips were acquired. Ensure tests strips are available at all times to ensure proper sanitizer concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 
Observed the caulk seal to be missing at the 3 part sink. Replace seal.
